points.title: 早年生活与教育
points.description: 塞尚出生于法国普罗旺斯地区艾克斯的一个富裕家庭。父亲是制帽商，后来成为银行家。塞尚在艾克斯接受了传统教育，同时展现出对绘画的兴趣。1852年进入波旁学院，与后来的作家埃米尔·左拉成为好友。这段时期，塞尚在父亲的期望下学习法律，但他对艺术的热情逐渐显现，最终在1858年说服家人允许他前往巴黎学习艺术。
points.descriptionEn: Cézanne was born in Aix-en-Provence to a wealthy family. His father was a hat manufacturer who later became a banker. Cézanne received traditional education in Aix while showing an interest in painting. In 1852, he entered the Bourbon College where he befriended future writer Émile Zola. During this period, under his father's wishes, Cézanne studied law, but his passion for art gradually emerged. In 1858, he convinced his family to allow him to go to Paris to study art.

points.title: 艺术探索与印象派接触
points.description: 塞尚首次前往巴黎，进入瑞士学院学习绘画。他受到印象派画家如马奈、雷诺阿的影响，但很快发展出自己独特的风格。1863年，他的作品《现代奥林匹亚》在落选者沙龙展出，引起争议。这一时期，塞尚与印象派画家建立了联系，参加了1874年和1877年的印象派画展，但他的作品受到冷遇。塞尚与左拉的友谊因艺术理念分歧而破裂，这对他的精神造成打击，促使他于1870年返回普罗旺斯。
points.descriptionEn: Cézanne first went to Paris and studied painting at the Swiss Academy. He was influenced by Impressionist painters like Manet and Renoir but soon developed his own distinctive style. In 1863, his work 'Modern Olympia' was exhibited at the Salon des Refusés, causing controversy. During this period, Cézanne connected with Impressionist painters and participated in the 1874 and 1877 Impressionist exhibitions, but his work received little recognition. His friendship with Zola deteriorated due to artistic differences, causing him emotional distress and prompting his return to Provence in 1870.

points.title: 隐居创作与风格形成
points.description: 返回艾克斯后，塞尚进入创作的重要时期。他开始探索自己独特的艺术语言，强调几何结构和形式感。这一时期，他创作了《玩纸牌者》、《圣维克多山》系列等代表作。塞尚与父亲的关系紧张，直到1886年父亲去世后才获得经济独立。他与妻子奥尔唐斯·菲凯育有一子，但婚姻并不幸福。塞尚在这一时期逐渐摆脱印象派的影响，发展出被称为'后印象派'的风格，为后来的立体主义和现代艺术奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: After returning to Aix, Cézanne entered a crucial period of creation. He began exploring his unique artistic language, emphasizing geometric structure and form. During this time, he created masterpieces such as 'The Card Players' and the series 'Mont Sainte-Victoire'. His relationship with his father was strained until his father's death in 1886, after which he gained financial independence. He had a son with his wife Hortense Fiquet, but their marriage was unhappy. During this period, Cézanne gradually broke away from Impressionist influences, developing what would be called 'Post-Impressionist' style, laying the foundation for Cubism and modern art.

points.title: 成熟期创作与艺术突破
points.description: 获得经济独立后，塞尚的艺术创作进入成熟期。他继续探索形式与色彩的关系，创作了《浴者》系列、《大浴女》等重要作品。塞尚在这一时期开始受到年轻艺术家的关注，包括后来成为他助手的埃米尔·贝尔纳。他的艺术理念逐渐成熟，提出'用圆柱体、球体和圆锥体来处理自然'的观点。塞尚的作品虽然仍不被主流艺术界接受，但他坚持自己的艺术道路，不断实验新的表现手法，为20世纪现代艺术的发展铺平了道路。
points.descriptionEn: After gaining financial independence, Cézanne's artistic creation entered its mature period. He continued to explore the relationship between form and color, creating important works such as the 'Bathers' series and 'The Large Bathers'. During this time, he began to attract the attention of younger artists, including Émile Bernard, who later became his assistant. His artistic philosophy gradually matured, proposing the idea of 'treating nature in terms of the cylinder, the sphere, and the cone'. Although his works were still not accepted by the mainstream art world, Cézanne persisted in his artistic path, constantly experimenting with new methods of expression, paving the way for the development of 20th-century modern art.

points.title: 晚年创作与艺术遗产
points.description: 晚年塞尚继续创作，但健康状况逐渐恶化。他坚持每天在户外作画，即使在恶劣天气条件下也不停止。1906年，他在户外作画时淋雨，导致肺炎发作，于10月22日去世。塞尚的晚年作品如《苹果与橘子》等展现了他对色彩和形式的完美掌控。在他去世后，他的艺术价值逐渐被认可，对马蒂斯、毕加索等现代艺术大师产生了深远影响。塞尚被誉为'现代艺术之父'，他的艺术理念和方法为立体主义和抽象艺术的发展奠定了基础，彻底改变了西方艺术的进程。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years, Cézanne continued to paint despite deteriorating health. He insisted on painting outdoors every day, even in adverse weather conditions. In 1906, he caught pneumonia after being caught in the rain while painting outdoors and died on October 22. His late works, such as 'Apples and Oranges', demonstrate his mastery of color and form. After his death, his artistic value was gradually recognized, profoundly influencing modern masters like Matisse and Picasso. Cézanne is hailed as the 'father of modern art', and his artistic philosophy and methods laid the foundation for the development of Cubism and abstract art, fundamentally changing the course of Western art.

supporter.zh: 塞尚被誉为现代艺术之父，他的艺术革命彻底改变了西方绘画的进程。支持者认为他通过几何化的形式处理和对色彩结构的探索，为立体主义和抽象艺术开辟了道路。塞尚坚持艺术独立性，拒绝迎合主流艺术界，这种精神激励了后世无数艺术家。他对自然本质的探索和对形式语言的创新，使他从印象派的传统中脱颖而出，成为连接19世纪与20世纪艺术的关键人物。
supporter.en: Cézanne is hailed as the father of modern art, and his artistic revolution fundamentally changed the course of Western painting. Supporters believe that through his geometric treatment of forms and exploration of color structure, he paved the way for Cubism and abstract art. Cézanne's insistence on artistic independence and refusal to cater to the mainstream art world inspired countless later artists. His exploration of the essence of nature and innovation in formal language distinguished him from Impressionist tradition, making him a key figure connecting 19th and 20th-century art.

critic.zh: 批评者指出塞尚的作品在生前几乎未得到认可，他的艺术理念过于理论化，缺乏情感表达。一些评论家认为他的几何化处理使画面显得僵硬，失去了艺术的生动性。塞尚与家人关系紧张，尤其是与父亲的冲突和与左拉的决裂，反映了他性格中的固执和社交障碍。此外，他对传统绘画技法的拒绝和对商业成功的漠视，导致他生前生活困顿，这也成为后人批评他脱离现实、不切实际的依据。
critic.en: Critics point out that Cézanne's works received little recognition during his lifetime, and his artistic philosophy was overly theoretical, lacking emotional expression. Some commentators argue that his geometric treatment made the compositions appear rigid, losing the vitality of art. Cézanne's strained relationships with family, especially conflicts with his father and the rupture with Zola, reflect his stubbornness and social difficulties. Additionally, his rejection of traditional painting techniques and indifference to commercial success led to financial hardship during his life, which later became a basis for criticism that he was detached from reality and impractical.

objective.zh: 从历史与流行文化视角看，塞尚被定位为艺术史上的关键转折点人物。他既不是完全的印象派，也不是现代主义的先驱，而是连接两个时代的桥梁。塞尚的艺术理念和方法影响了毕加索、马蒂斯等现代大师，立体主义直接受其启发。在流行文化中，塞尚常被描绘为孤独的天才形象，他的生活故事和艺术坚持成为艺术家的理想象征。他的作品，尤其是圣维克多山系列，已成为艺术史上的标志性图像，代表着对自然本质的永恒探索。
objective.en: From a historical and popular culture perspective, Cézanne is positioned as a pivotal figure in art history. He was neither a complete Impressionist nor a pioneer of modernism, but a bridge connecting two eras. His artistic philosophy and methods influenced modern masters like Picasso and Matisse, with Cubism directly inspired by his work. In popular culture, Cézanne is often depicted as a lonely genius, and his life story and artistic persistence have become symbols of the ideal artist. His works, especially the Mont Sainte-Victoire series, have become iconic images in art history, representing the eternal exploration of the essence of nature.

self.zh: 我想用圆柱体、球体和圆锥体来处理自然，以便让一切，从自然到我的感受，都回归到几何秩序。
self.en: I want to make of Impressionism something solid and lasting, like the art of museums.

others.zh: 塞尚是我们所有人的父亲，一位艺术上的父亲。
others.en: Cézanne is the father of us all, a father in terms of art.
